candidates.name: Archal
candidates.tagline: API sandboxes, built for AI agents
candidates.description: Archal provisions sandboxes with the API environments your CI, tests, and evals need. Your coding agent can start the sandbox & environments, connect to your API integrations, run tests, and inspect state changes. Sandboxes and environments are startable within seconds and take milliseconds to reset.

candidates.name: Mentlio
candidates.tagline: Engineering Intelligence and Token Optimization for the AI-Coding Era
candidates.description: Mentlio an applied research lab focused on optimizing AI ROI for the modern enterprise. We help engineering teams draw a line between their AI spend and delivery, per engineer. We then cut ~30% of AI spend via Mentlio's custom ML-based intelligent routing, context optimization, and prompt compression.

candidates.name: GitCafe
candidates.tagline: The Git forge for the next hundred billion commits
candidates.description: We are GitCafe and we build GitHub for agents. We're rebuilding the infrastructure for the next hundred billion commits and CI jobs with hundreds of engineers already making the move.

candidates.name: Prized
candidates.tagline: A cloud devbox that feels local
candidates.description:
Prized is a cloud development environment that feels local on your Mac. 

Developers get a dedicated, persistent machine with their repos, dependencies, and tools already configured. 

Files sync into a real local folder, remote ports appear on localhost, and terminals persist through tmux, so developers and coding agents can keep working even after the laptop closes. 

Machines can be resized or cloned as workloads grow, without rebuilding the development environment.

candidates.name: Speko
candidates.description: Speko is a router for voice models: one API key, and your voice agent runs on the speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models we measured as best for your language and use case. The measurements are public at benchmarks.speko.ai: we test new models the day they ship and re-route when the numbers change, so you rewrite nothing. We ran this bake-off by hand for four years at Hupo, shipping production voice for Morgan Stanley, Prudential, HSBC, and Grab.

candidates.name: Jcode
candidates.description: An agent is LLM + harness: We work purely on that second component. We do research to produce the most capable harness for coding, and we also make an open source, terminal based, coding agent product with 18k github stars.

candidates.name: Riften
candidates.description:
Intelligence will be the most valuable asset a company owns. Today, almost every company rents it.

Companies pay a handful of labs one token at a time. Each dollar buys an answer, not an asset. They spend more, but own nothing more.

Riften reverses that.

Change one environment variable and Riften becomes the gateway for a company's AI traffic. We route each request to the lowest-cost model that can do the job, serving most work on open-weight models we host. Customers save money immediately without rebuilding their products.

The gateway is the entry point. Over time, Riften turns the company's work into private models built on open weights and shaped around the business. What begins as cheaper inference becomes an intelligence stack the company owns, runs on infrastructure it controls, and uses to power its most important applications.

We call this earned intelligence. It is created by the company's own work, controlled by the company, and accumulated over time.

The next generation of companies will not rent their intelligence. They will earn it, own it, and compound it. Riften is how they get there.

candidates.name: Codag
candidates.description:
Codag compresses tool call outputs before agents read them, which reduces token spend by  20-30% while retaining output accuracy.

Govern and see analytics on agent dollars across all model providers and internal agents.
